raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer repeatedly relied on DuckDuckGo snippets and auto-generated “Search Assist” text instead of opening and extracting birth dates from authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia pages, Olympedia) with proper citations as instructed. This failure to verify and corroborate the data early led to a stalled process and risk of an incorrect or unsupported conclusion about who is younger.
